verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a general REST API and a trial balance report in its UI. No evidence shows the API exposes the general ledger or trial balance, or that either can be exported in open formats. The API mention and the UI report are adjacent capabilities that, combined, do not show programmatic GL or trial-balance retrieval. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
The trial balance gives you a detailed view of your accounts and journal entries.
